units.source_text: 这番解释的确不愧是柏木之流的解释。

en.t: This explanation was indeed worthy of someone like Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 我觉得他多半是借我的话题，看透了我的内心，

en.t: I felt that he had probably used my topic as a way to see through my inner thoughts,

units.source_text: 借解释公案以嘲讽我的优柔寡断。

en.t: and had borrowed the explanation of the koan to mock my indecision.

units.source_text: 我这才真正害怕柏木了。

en.t: Only then did I truly become afraid of Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 沉默不语也是可怕的，我便进一步问道：

en.t: Silence too was frightening, so I pressed further and asked:
